Dangerous Goods

ถังเหล็ก

A cylindrical container made of steel, used to transport liquids or solids, including regulated dangerous goods under UN codes (e.g., UN1A1/UN1A2).

Quick answer: A cylindrical container made of steel, used to transport liquids or solids, including regulated dangerous goods under UN codes (e.g., UN1A1/UN1A2).

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is ถังเหล็ก?

In this glossary, ถังเหล็ก refers to: A cylindrical container made of steel, used to transport liquids or solids, including regulated dangerous goods under UN codes (e.g., UN1A1/UN1A2).

How is ถังเหล็ก used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "ของเหลวจำนวนมากที่จัดเป็นวัตถุอันตรายต้องบรรจุในถังเหล็กที่ได้รับการรับรองจากสหประชาชาติสำหรับการขนส่งระหว่างประเทศ"

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A cylindrical container made of steel, used to transport liquids or solids, including regulated dangerous goods under UN codes (e.g., UN1A1/UN1A2).

Operational example

Bulk liquids classified as dangerous goods must be packed in UN-approved steel drums for international transport.
